clauses: This individual was a notable biologist, anthropologist, zoologist, and naturalist who contributed significantly to the field of evolution.

Recognized for their profound impact on science, they were awarded the Copley Medal, the Royal Medal, the Darwin Medal, and the Linnean Medal, and were also made an Honorary Fellow of the Royal Society Te Apārangi.
Additionally, they were a prolific writer.
Despite their extensive contributions to evolutionary theory, this scientist never worked as a paleontologist and was not educated at University College London.
